_provenance.source: written by this compiler, validated against dist/index/semantic-contract.json

bindingNotes: No AiExport artifact for this system, so no selector is known and every placeholder stays unbound.

notes: The target entity is set by `parent`, not by a property. `entity` is ReadOnly on a report, so this is the only way to say which entity the report runs over -- and it cannot be changed afterwards.
`reportType` uses the AiExport vocabulary (`list`), not the CLR enum member (`ViewResults`). The mapping between them is Inferred; see REPORT-TYPES.md.
`condition: {"all": []}` is an empty condition. `all` and `any` line up with CombinationOperator. The comparison operator vocabulary is Unknown, so no filled condition is shown.
recipes.purpose: The smallest useful report: pick an entity, pick columns, done.
recipes.title: A list report on an existing entity

notes: The canonical path is System -> Page -> Group -> Report placement, and the Host's folder reference states it. Page and Group are both FolderType.ReportFolder at runtime; the hierarchy carries the semantics, not the runtime type.

One wave, not four. The planner collects tempIds from `target`, `parent` and recursively from `properties`, so every dependency here is expressible with a temporary reference. Split a batch only when the contract needs a persisted id read back.
A same-batch reference carries both `objectType` and `tempId`. A bare `{"tempId": ...}` is not the documented shape.
`kind` is a create-only enum; its values are documented. See common/PLACEMENT.md.
Page and Group names come from the requirement. The Host does not invent them, so these two are the rows to edit.
Reuse before you create: if a suitable Page or Group already exists, placing under it needs a folder selector, which this pack still cannot supply. See MISSING-FROM-DIST.md.
recipes.purpose: A report nobody can navigate to is invisible. This builds the placement path with it, in one wave.
recipes.title: A list report, delivered with its navigation

notes: `columns` is writable on update, so the whole column list is replaced. There is no evidence in dist/ of a per-column patch, so replacing the list is the only form shown.
The report is addressed by `target`, by selector. `entity` and `system` cannot appear here: both are ReadOnly.
recipes.title: Change the columns of an existing report

notes: A delete carries no `properties`. `report` lists Delete among its supported operations, so the operation is available; what it does to the report's placement rows is Unknown.
recipes.purpose: Included because `report` supports Delete and the shape differs.
recipes.title: Delete a report

notes: `reportType: "form"` and a `typeView` selector is the shape the Push Notification artifact shows.
`typeView` is writable on create and update, and takes a view selector.
recipes.purpose: The second reportType actually observed in an artifact.
recipes.title: A form report over a view

notes: Every property here is writable on both create and update, so the same body works as an update with `target` instead of `parent`.
recipes.purpose: Shows the permission and paging groups, which are where most of the 80 properties live.
recipes.title: A read-only list report with paging
